title: Iron and Tide
opens: The Forge and the Sea Pier
reward: 3,500g, a recruit and 250 Farm Rank points

scenes.title: The Cold Forge
outline: Ida Stone relights the farm’s cold forge with ore from your Mine
Merging: two of a kind make one better; your best smith works the bellows
Tools made better here dig deeper, fish farther and cut cleaner
Captain Nils Berg at the Sea Pier: his old boat, for sale to a farm that can pay for it, and the deep sea’s fish

scenes.title: First Tide Out
outline: The boat’s first trip out, and a hold of sea fish
Ida and Nils toast the farm on the pier; Nils gives you his old compass
Your newest hand at the Gate
The Mayor brings the Harvest Cup’s poster: this winter the farm runs; chapter 8 Soon
